sigs.label: fund M 0.12, T 0.12, X 0.03 SOL (enough for mint ATAs and escrow rent)
create mint A (the deposited token) (6 decimals, payer is mint authority)
create mint B (what the maker wants in return) (6 decimals, payer is mint authority)
create ATA M / mint A
create ATA M / mint B
create ATA T / mint A
create ATA T / mint B
create ATA X / mint A
mint 1000 of mint A to M
mint 1000 of mint B to T
M creates escrow #1: deposits 10 of mint A, wants 5 of mint B
M refunds escrow #1 (the take never ran, so the 10 of mint A is still in the vault)
M creates escrow #2 asking for 10_000 of mint B (more than T holds) — take is the same crashing instruction, so this is about create with a large want
M refunds escrow #2
mint 50 of mint A to the UI test wallet for the DAS token list
mint 50 of mint B to the UI test wallet for the DAS token list
return unspent SOL to the payer
return unspent SOL to the payer
return unspent SOL to the payer
